boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 116 wraps perimeter arrows around a central orange-bordered `6` pocket — the arrows are live exits, not decoration. A bottom color-counter tray tracks progress, and the side arrows must open in sequence to avoid trapping the white-bordered purple square in the center-right. Force the purple square through while the bottom counters are still high and the tray seals shut.
landmarks: Block Out Level 116 wraps perimeter arrows around a central orange-bordered `6` pocket — the arrows are live exits, not decoration.
A bottom color-counter tray tracks progress, and the side arrows must open in sequence to avoid trapping the white-bordered purple square in the center-right.
Force the purple square through while the bottom counters are still high and the tray seals shut.

quickTips: The bottom counter tray is a seal — wait until the center-right purple highlight clears.
Keep the cyan `12`/`10` pair parked until the middle channel actually widens.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the top-left blue `8` and the green top cluster without touching the central orange-bordered `6` pocket.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the red left-arrow column down and clear the bottom-left red `11` tile.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed the cyan `12` and paired `10` tiles through the bottom center once the middle channel opens.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the highlighted white-bordered purple square in the center-right to unlock the blue right-arrow exit.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Close the bottom-tray blue `10`, `8`, and `4` counters before spending the purple `7` pair.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the last green 1x1 and the remaining perimeter arrow exits until the 6x6 grid empties.

failurePoints: Spending the bottom counter tray before the center-right purple highlight clears — this seals the blue right-arrow exit.
Feeding the cyan `12`/`10` pair too early while the central `6` pocket is still boxed in.
